payoff_math_recheck.independent_direct_leg_expression: S_T - max(S_T - K_C, 0) + max(K_P - S_T, 0) + C - P
payoff_math_recheck.formula_provenance: Generic derivative payoff algebra only; it is not an SSE rule, market-data-interface or exchange formula.

payoff_math_recheck.conditioned_identity_test: PASS over the same grid whenever K_P <= K_C.
payoff_math_recheck.return_boundary: The formula bounds an abstract terminal payoff only. It neither supplies a positive return floor nor establishes a historical, cost-adjusted or executable result.
